public_rationale: The report documents continued close competition, which is consistent with Marcus's view. It cannot establish that neither country will eventually win. More fundamentally, continuation of the full antecedent remains unknown: benchmark convergence alone does not verify continuing similarities in methods and data. Under the conditional-forecast rule, this cannot yet receive an outcome score. The forecast also has no deadline or defined victory threshold.
limitations: This is not a finding that the forecast is false.
Interpreting 'current trends' as benchmark convergence alone would permit an unresolved assessment, but would narrow the antecedent beyond its surrounding explanation.
Leaderboard rankings do not establish commercial or geopolitical victory.
